en: Black-and-white interior view of a rustic dining hall or restaurant with wooden tables and chairs, long tables covered with patterned cloths and potted plants, a wooden floor, and shelves at the back filled with bottles and glassware. Round decorative objects hang high on the walls, and two large hanging lamps are suspended from the ceiling. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge and a handwritten number is visible in the lower right corner.
